source: Five user photographs of Português a Valer 3 glossary: visible pages 212, 214, and three photographs with printed page numbers outside the frame
normalization_notes: Assistant visual transcription of Portuguese and English columns only. Other languages and internal lesson-page numbers were not transcribed except the two suspender references (114 and 131) distinguishing duplicate rows.
Printed page numbers are visible only on images 1 (212) and 2 (214). Images 3, 4 and 5 retain page=null and stable image-based identifiers; no page numbers were guessed.
Preserve original articles, expressions, capitalization, punctuation, duplicate rows and source English in extracted JSON. Lowercase and NFC-normalize vocabulary and remove article annotations.
Split expressions and reflexive clitics into individually translated components. Preserve lexical compounds sem-número, xeque-mate, todo-o-terreno, projeto-piloto and público-alvo.
Keep inflected forms as printed (e.g. trisavós, baterias, recarregadas, pés, assentes); do not silently lemmatize.
Duplicate suspender source rows are preserved and merged into one word. The two vaga senses are preserved separately and merged into one word with both meanings.
Ukrainian translations, CEFR estimates, group assignments, English corrections and translations of components are assistant supplied and not independently reviewed.
Use only thematic/grammatical groups. The user-supplied B1 book level is metadata; individual estimated word levels may differ.
No database connection or import is performed. Each source batch is a separate replayable backup.

enrichment_provenance.english: Printed English retained unchanged in rows/source_senses; reuse where appropriate. Component translations and corrections are assistant supplied.
enrichment_provenance.groups: Assistant assignments to existing topic names.

corrections.note: The article marks a noun, not the adjective countless.
Two printed rows distinguish wave (English printed as front) and job vacancy (position). Both meanings preserved separately in rows and merged for vocabulary.
Portuguese is an adjective; printed kidney is a noun.
Portuguese entry is an adjective. Printed to be of modest means retained in source.
Printed country is context-dependent; usual standalone meaning is territory.
Printed testament may be misleading; testimony/evidence is the usual sense.

corrections.corrected_english: to resist; to withstand; to endure
corrections.note: Printed to survive is contextual; preserve and clarify the base verb.
Portuguese is an adjective rather than a finite verb.

uncertainties: Printed page numbers are not visible on images 3, 4 and 5; recorded as null, with stable image identifiers.
Expressions remain context-dependent; complete expressions and original glosses are retained in source rows.
Live database duplicate/conflict comparison has not run.
